S.FORM: ʔuuna miana maanu nannakə, mia ʔuuna=pa cuuma, ʔakia=cu cina-ini.
S.PHON: ʔuuna miana maanu nannakə mia ʔuunapa ʦuuma ʔakiaʦu tʂinaini
S.FORM: 'uuna miana maanu nannake, mia 'uunapa cuuma, 'akiacu cinaini.
S.PHON: ʔuuna miana maanu nannake mia ʔuunapa ʦuuma ʔakiaʦu tʂinaini
S.TRANSL: In the past, there was a little girl, who still had her father, but not her mother.

S.FORM: sua iisua ia, mu-a-kusa=kani ʔuma-ʔuma-ini tia=kirimi taavu.
S.PHON: sua iisua ia muakusakani ʔumaʔumaini tiakirimi taavu
S.FORM: sua iisua ia, muakusakani 'uma'umaini tiakirimi taavu.
S.PHON: sua iisua ia muakusakani ʔumaʔumaini tiaki[r|ɾ]imi taavu
S.TRANSL: She went to the field to look for a calabash.
She walked back and forth, and there was no calabash.
There was one, but it was overripe.
She seated it in a mortar, but it fell down.

S.FORM: pasa-vali-ai=kani ʔinia na taar-ini, makasua=kani m-i-ravəkə.
S.PHON: pasavaɾiaikani ʔinia na taarini makasuakani miravəkə
pasava[r|ɾ]iaikani ʔinia na taa[r|ɾ]ini makasuakani mi[r|ɾ]aveke
S.TRANSL: She moved it onto her bed, it fell down also.
The little girl was thinking it over.
She moved it under her bed.

S.FORM: makasua=cu mia ruu-vana=ci i-vatu=kani sua nanmaluan saruanai.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu mia ruuvanatʂi ivatukani sua nanmaɾuan saruanai
S.FORM: makasuacu mia ruuvanaci ivatukani sua nanmaruan saruanai.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu mia [r|ɾ]uuvanatʂi ivatukani sua nanma[r|ɾ]uan sa[r|ɾ]uanai
S.TRANSL: A young man came in the evening.

S.FORM: tia=tasiʔarə cəʔəra-i=kani ʔinia, ʔaisi=kani nakənakə taar-ini sua taavu.
S.PHON: tiataʂiʔarə ʦəʔəraikani ʔinia ʔaiʂikani nakənakə taarini sua taavu
S.FORM: tiatasi'are ce'eraikani 'inia, 'aisikani nakenake taarini sua taavu.
S.PHON: tiataʂiʔa[r|ɾ]e ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]aikani ʔinia ʔaiʂikani nakenake taa[r|ɾ]ini sua taavu
S.TRANSL: In the morning she was to look at him, but the calabash was under her bed.

S.FORM: sua iisua ia, ŋuai c<in>əʔəra=kiai mia ruu-vana maanu saruanai iisa.
S.PHON: sua iisua ia ŋuai tʂinəʔərakiai mia ruuvana maanu saruanai iisa
S.FORM: sua iisua ia, nguai c<in>e'erakiai mia ruuvana maanu saruanai iisa.
S.PHON: sua iisua ia ŋuai tʂineʔe[r|ɾ]akiai mia [r|ɾ]uuvana maanu sa[r|ɾ]uanai iisa
S.TRANSL: He was the young man she had seen last night.
